# Baseline A Narrative Synthesis: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

Case: test-biotech-recursion-2021
Cutoff: 2021-04-15
Input fingerprint: 1b39a39cf696

## Narrative
- Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is summarized from 2 cutoff-visible public evidence records dated on or before 2021-04-15.
- The normalized claim list contains 8 cited observations from source classes: regulatory-filing.
- Recursion described itself as a clinical-stage biotechnology company using technology to decode biology.
- Recursion described the Recursion OS as combining infrastructure, biological datasets, algorithms and machine-learning tools.
- Recursion filed a Form S-1 registration statement for its initial public offering before the cutoff.
- The S-1 identifies the registrant as Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001601830.
- The final prospectus describes Class A shares with one vote and Class B shares with ten votes per share.

## Evidence Notes
- Recursion Pharmaceuticals Form S-1 [ev-95a848a8ee5a]
  - Recursion described itself as a clinical-stage biotechnology company using technology to decode biology. (value=clinical-stage biotechnology company; period=instant 2021-03-22)
  - Recursion described the Recursion OS as combining infrastructure, biological datasets, algorithms and machine-learning tools. (value=Recursion OS platform; period=instant 2021-03-22)
  - Recursion filed a Form S-1 registration statement for its initial public offering before the cutoff. (value=true; period=instant 2021-03-22)
  - The S-1 identifies the registrant as Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc., incorporated in Delaware, with CIK 0001601830. (value=SEC-CIK-0001601830; unit=SEC CIK; period=instant 2021-03-22)
- Recursion Pharmaceuticals final prospectus [ev-da68c304b2cc]
  - The final prospectus describes Class A shares with one vote and Class B shares with ten votes per share. (value=Class A: one vote, Class B: ten votes; period=instant 2021-04-15)
  - The final prospectus states Recursion was offering 24,242,424 shares of Class A common stock. (value=24242424; unit=Class A shares offered; period=instant 2021-04-15)
  - The final prospectus states an initial public offering price of USD 18.00 per share. (value=18; unit=USD per share; period=instant 2021-04-15)
  - The final prospectus states total initial public offering price of USD 436,363,632 before deductions. (value=436.363632; unit=USD millions gross offering value; period=instant 2021-04-15)

## Limitations
- This baseline performs deterministic evidence summarization only.
- It does not run TRACE route selection, sufficiency gating, valuation logic, or adversarial review.
- It does not claim official contest compliance, benchmark superiority, investment advice, or appraisal status.
- Source use follows the committed policy: Raw source documents, PDFs, cached pages, and scratch downloads stay out of Git unless redistribution rights are explicitly established.
